import csv
from collections import defaultdict
data = defaultdict(list)
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    for r in csv.DictReader(f):
        data[r["timeseries_id"]].append((r["timestamp"], float(r["value"])))

zones = {
 # zone: (temp, cool_sp, heat_sp)
 "Z01": ("baef86cb-2941-5d61-87b0-ffa91d79f23a","1213f3a8-c23d-55b5-8187-4712d49a82ae","c5120bcb-e5c2-5714-a171-cbdb1f8ef5ab"),
 "Z02": ("6a2dc2f5-9a81-548b-84d2-df34d1516503","67adf9a4-536e-5f42-bb3b-51b7a1526675",None),
 "Z03": ("75411709-a1c3-5621-904d-b03d146bc43d","44d6581d-51ed-5650-ad74-1bd56a16c03e",None),
 "Z04": ("f9990edd-406b-5118-8fc2-62ecc998fe86","f0c17382-5dc5-5762-aef6-7d433ca8d7bb",None),
 "Z05": ("108335ab-9ad0-5222-b9a5-88d998152c65","335c2ab2-c7e3-551f-8bdc-96b15c59e4a8",None),
 "Z08": ("be41bf6b-c1ca-5cc0-a271-2cd4fca56654","3ec6613e-4d87-5159-ac83-7852e7c94984",None),
 "Z09": ("e1a79a88-2d8b-57bd-bf62-59a3912057c5","e75277fa-4749-5dba-8c4f-d26f1e36883e",None),
}
# Compute daily mean temp and mean cool_sp for each weekday/day in May and July, plus occupied hours 9-17
def agg(ts_key, key):
    rows = dict(data[ts_key])
    # filter to May-July 2018
    import datetime
    res = {}
    for ts,v in rows.items():
        d = ts[:10]
        if d.startswith("2018-05") or d.startswith("2018-06") or d.startswith("2018-07"):
            h = int(ts[11:13])
            if 9<=h<17:
                res.setdefault(d, []).append(v)
    return res

temps = {z: agg(v[0]) for z,v in zones.items()}
sp = {z: agg(v[1]) for z,v in zones.items()}

import statistics
for z in zones:
    d0 = sorted(temps[z])
    print(z, "May days:", d0[:5], "... Jul:", d0[-5:])
    may = [statistics.mean(temps[z][d]) for d in d0 if d.startswith("2018-05")]
    july = [statistics.mean(temps[z][d]) for d in d0 if d.startswith("2018-07")]
    print("  ", z, "May occupied mean:", round(statistics.mean(may),2), " July occupied mean:", round(statistics.mean(july),2), " delta:", round(statistics.mean(july)-statistics.mean(may),2))
    sps = sp[z]
    dss = sorted(set(list(sp[z]))|set(temps[z]))
    may_sp = [statistics.mean(sp[z][d]) for d in dss if d.startswith("2018-05")]
    july_sp = [statistics.mean(sp[z][d]) for d in dss if d.startswith("2018-07")]
    print("    SP May:", round(statistics.mean(may_sp),2), " SP July:", round(statistics.mean(july_sp),2))

content.text: The data clearly shows: Zone_F2_Z01 (Core_bottom) zone air temp dropped ~1.9°C from May→July during occupied hours, and its occupied cooling setpoint dropped by roughly the same amount (~0.9–1.9°C) starting around mid-June. All other core zones (Z02–Z05) are unchanged in both temperature and setpoint. A shift in one zone only, tracking the zone's own setpoint change, is a local controller/offset change — a schedule change would affect all zones simultaneously (and other zone setpoints are unchanged).
